product.name: ExampleSaaS
product.oneLine: A placeholder SaaS that helps teams complete a core workflow.
product.coreValueProposition: Teams complete the core workflow faster with shared visibility and controlled access.
product.problem: Teams manage this workflow manually and lose time/status/context.
product.solution: A workspace-based dashboard with structured records, collaboration, and usage-based access.
product.successMetric: First core action completed within 10 minutes of signup.

personas.name: Workspace Admin
personas.jobToBeDone: Set up workspace and manage team access

userFlows.name: Signup and create workspace
userFlows.successState: Workspace exists and first action is complete

nonGoals: Do not build complex enterprise features in MVP
assumptions: External identity provider will be used
risks: Billing and entitlement coupling can create bugs if not separated

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An authenticated admin can create a workspace and see it in the dashboard

edgeCases.case: User attempts to access another organization's workspace
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: 403 or not found; no data leaked
